scope: Native Windows x64 source-assisted rebuild and focused validation; not a complete playthrough.

source_correspondence.interpretation: Matching named functions establish close correspondence, not a byte-identical rebuild.

clean_preparation.method: scripts/prepare.py into a separate clean directory; compare 3073 engine files and all 18 BASIC files to compiled sources, normalizing line endings.

full_game_checks: Main menu, character creator, courtroom, prison introduction and location 9 gameplay rendered with supplied original assets.
Keyboard movement and turning exercised in a disposable installation.
F12 creates 800x600 BMPs; repeated menu captures retain the logo after the final rendering fix.
Character portrait and slot thumbnail are nonblack BMPs.
Esc saves progress and returns to the slot menu.
Window close during gameplay saved slot 2 and exited with status 0.
Restart displayed the saved slot name and thumbnail; selecting the slot restored gameplay.
Final portable launcher created a Data backup, excluded a second launch, and exited with status 0 after window close; stderr contained only OpenGL initialization metadata.
The six supplied Data files remain byte-identical in the final portable installation.
not_validated: Loading this port's saves in the original 32-bit executable; serialization bytes are covered by regressions
assets: Supplied locally; game assets and original executables excluded from Git.
artifact_note: Historical initial-port validation and artifact hashes; current Windows artifact hashes are in windows-build.json.
